title: Zelensky says Putin must understand Crimean Bridge 'will not stay,' warns Russia increasing double-tap strikes
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that Russia is increasing its double-tap strikes and even conducting triple-tap strikes to "kill as many people as possible" in its attacks.

title: Incoming Democratic chairman warns US lawmakers could halt SpaceX funding following Starshield slowdown in Ukraine, CNN reports
summary: "Simply, our committee cannot authorize funds for the development of government systems that the government will not fully control," Democratic Rep. James Himes wrote.

title: Ukraine's anti-graft agencies say they face smear campaign as probes reach 'core of corruption system'
summary: According to NABU Director Semen Kryvonos, the campaign aims to "shift the focus from the investigations to politics, conspiracy theories, and lies."
